command:
set -eu
KS="$MIRRORD_PARAM_KEYSPACE"
src() { cqlsh "$MIRRORD_PARAM_HOST" "$MIRRORD_PARAM_PORT" ${MIRRORD_PARAM_USER:+-u "$MIRRORD_PARAM_USER" -p "$MIRRORD_PARAM_PASSWORD"} "$@"; }
dst() { cqlsh "$MIRRORD_BRANCH_HOST" "$MIRRORD_BRANCH_PORT" "$@"; }
src -e "DESCRIBE KEYSPACE $KS" > /tmp/raw.cql
sed -E "s/(CREATE KEYSPACE [^ ]+ WITH replication = )\{[^}]*\}/\1{'class': 'NetworkTopologyStrategy', 'replication_factor': 1}/" /tmp/raw.cql > /tmp/schema.cql
dst -f /tmp/schema.cql
src -e "SELECT table_name FROM system_schema.tables WHERE keyspace_name = '$KS'" > /tmp/tables.txt
sed -n '/^---/,/^$/p' /tmp/tables.txt | sed -e '/^---/d' -e '/^$/d' -e 's/ //g' > /tmp/tables.list
for t in $$(cat /tmp/tables.list); do
  src -e "COPY $KS.$t TO '/tmp/$t.csv'"
  dst -e "COPY $KS.$t FROM '/tmp/$t.csv'"
done
echo "copied keyspace $KS: $$(wc -l < /tmp/tables.list) tables"
